fluid_identification.interpretation: Very high resistivity indicates gas-bearing sections. Minimal water saturation (10%).

porosity_estimation.interpretation: Excellent porosity development in sand bodies. Zones >28% porosity represent premium pay.

permeability_estimation.interpretation: High permeability suitable for gas production. Expected high decline curves post-production.

saturation_analysis.interpretation: Exceptional hydrocarbon saturation (90%) across multiple stacked sand intervals.

pressure_prediction.interpretation: Normal hydrostatic pressure regime. Gas bearing with no pressure depletion concerns.

trap_evaluation.interpretation: Large, well-defined trap with excellent seal. Growth fault provides high-quality trap geometry.

volumetric_estimates.interpretation: Significant gas reserves (16.9 BCF equivalent). Multiple stacked intervals provide volume.

seal_integrity.interpretation: Exceptionally thick and competent seal (350m). World-class trapping geometry.
